technical_events.detail: Logs larger than last16MiB cause nonadvancing next_offset; initial generic drain failed pagination, no completed full-page set claimed.
CUA initialization failed to write kernel assets; no installation/restart attempted.
Used verified local research container on9200 and normal dashboard authentication/download endpoint; credentials stayed only in process memory and were not emitted.
